summary: From a blank file you write ask_cited.py: for five questions, check the best similarity, refuse under 0.6, otherwise answer with a citation. Then you find a question with a high score and no answer, and fix it with hybrid search.
goal: Answer with citations and refuse when there is no source, from a blank file.

items.text: Write down which of the five questions will be answered and which refused
Write ask_cited.py from the contract, without the solution
Run it and compare it with the solution
Read the E104 line, then swap retrieve for hybrid_search
Play the Cite or Refuse game to the end and see your score
